title: Webflow Review 2026: Pricing, Features, and Honest Verdict
summary: Webflow gives the deepest design-canvas control tested, but it falls short on pricing simplicity, backend depth, and non-technical usability. Here's why Blink is the more complete platform.
body_markdown: Blink. It covers Webflow's core gaps natively, one flat price instead of stacked Site, Workspace, and Ecommerce plans, a full general-purpose backend instead of a capped Cloud add-on, and no-code usability instead of a canvas-first workflow, and it's a more complete platform overall: a customer-facing AI gateway, growth tooling, and agentic AI features are all things Webflow doesn't offer at this price point.
